Description: Tukwila is a suburban South King County city in the Seattle metropolitan area, situated along the Duwamish River adjacent to Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. It is a major regional commercial and aerospace hub home to Westfield Southcenter and Boeing facilities, offering convenient access to Seattle VA health care, no state individual income tax, and extensive retail amenities alongside higher combined sales taxes.
